Privacy Note

What is stored: Your permanent Firebase User ID, unique chosen username, avatar emoji, personal scores, and score challenges sent/received.

Who can see it: Other players can ONLY see your username, avatar emoji, and game scores on leaderboards and shared challenge messages. Your Google email address is never stored in public collections or shown to other players.

How to delete it: You can permanently delete your player profile, username, scores, and leaderboard entries at any time from your Profile settings using the "Delete my account" button.
